title: Ordered simplicial join
statement: For simplicial sets $X,Y$ of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] in the fixed universe, define their ordered join $X\star Y$ degreewise by $(X\star Y)_n=X_n\amalg Y_n\amalg\coprod_{a+b+1=n}X_a\times Y_b$, with each simplicial operator restricting the ordered $X$-block followed by the $Y$-block.
